source.note: Independent transcription from the five-page English original; not imported from another experiment.

boundary_policy.vehicle: Field and building tangency allowed; the disk must not cross the field boundary or enter building interiors.
boundary_policy.line_of_sight: Any contact, including face/edge/vertex tangency, blocks observation; closed prisms and closed segments.
boundary_policy.elevation: The stated endpoints are included, in particular 80 degrees.
boundary_policy.numerics: Interior classification uses exact inequalities in double precision. Explicit contact tests use a stated 1e-10 m/t-parameter tolerance; tolerances are not physical clearance.
